body:
5 Year Old Acid & Hash (live rosin) - Surprisingly Active
Mindset: Had a good summer, getting ready to go back to university in about a week. Been seeing someone who I will have to say bye to for a bit (goes to school in another state). Gardening a lot, hanging out with friends, I smoke hash everyday and rarely do another drug at all, but If I do it's combined with weed. I did not intend to have a full trip this night, it has been at least 4-5 years since I tripped, and it was the same acid. It was stored in tinfoil in a book in my room. I have been reading and learning about psychedelics quite a bit recently. I had some friends over before, just talking and hanging out.
Setting: Bedroom, parents house. I also took a brief walk in the garden to check out the stars. Rural area, surrounded by forest.
Dose: Half tab of clearly oxidized acid, 10pm. I did not expect any noticeable effects (naively). Took a dab, watched Hamilton Morris's new Ariadne synthesis video in Shulgin's lab. Next, I was looking at Kykeon analytics and reading psychonaut wiki just for fun.
Around 12pm, I get up to pee, is it at this moment I start to feel weird. I was so focused on researching, that I did not notice I was completely tripping, mostly mental at this point. There was some nausea from eating pizza but also the acid did not help. I looked in the mirror and my depth perception was off, my pupils were huge, but for some reason I still was not so sure it was the acid
my depth perception was off, my pupils were huge, but for some reason I still was not so sure it was the acid
. I listened to music, took another dab and was journaling from 12pm until I went to bed. My motor function was clearly impaired, I felt anxious and stimulated. Also, euphoria and some very mild visuals, CEVs while listening to music and around 4am I went to pee again and the shampoo and conditioner bottles started morphing. Besides this no breathing or dramatically enhanced colors like I have experienced off the same dose years earlier.
Around 1:15am I was quite sure I was having a psychedelic experience. I wrote that cats always know when you are tripping, so I went to find one of my cats. I walked downstairs and saw Willa, she was energetic and I did not feel like playing. I went outside because that's what I left my room to do. I walked onto the patio and the lights were far too bright as I was trying to look at the stars. I walked into the garden in my socks to escape the light. The stars were beautiful, my field of vision was complete, I could presumably see the curvature of the atmosphere as satellites, and other unidentified objects flew across the sky. I imagined chemical structures connecting between stars and the flying flashing objects as positive charges flying in the air.  I looked at the unique architecture of the tomato plants in the garden, the rich smell of them. I became aware of strange sounds and the complete darkness. I was scared of the unidentified sounds that seemed to come out of nowhere and not stop, so I went back to my room.
I pondered the interconnectedness of all matter and energy. I thought about language and much more. When I stopped listening to music and was just writing, I noticed how the visuals were amplified.  My hand seemed to dance across the page effortlessly, with some kind of motion blur effect. Earlier I had written something along the lines of, I should be more tired than I am, which made me suspicious of a psychedelic experience. By 1:50am I was bored of writing and sure I was tripping, so I decided to open Pihkal.
The beauty of chemistry compelled me after reading Pihkal's sections on MDMA and Mescaline analogs. I did love chemistry before, but I feel I really got it now. I felt a sense of being on the right path and gratitude for life. I felt love for the molecules and constituent parts, as well the designers and manufacturers. Reading seemed easy, the words perfectly arranged on the page as if they were designed for me at that moment, or something like that. I was focused and stimulated.
2:32 am - Done reading Pihkal a great calming joy, I felt the peak tapering off, I ate a banana. 10 minutes later I was looking at the spark of a bic lighter and the significance of the visual phenomena it is. I thought about Huxleys The doors of perception and Heaven and Hell, where he describes how these sorts of commodified visual wonders are taken for granted. (Art, reflections, etc.)
Around 2:42am I write that I feel right enough for bed. At 2:53am I was listening to The future of humanity - Mckenna, Abraham, Sheldrake. I had been listening to these figures on youtube for some time before the trip.
3:25am - Brushed my teeth, eyes big AF still feel altered. I watched a video on coelacanths because I remembered Hamilton Morris saying how amazed he was at them, I too was amazed. Its geometry reminded me of the painted lady butterfly.
3:36am - I would like to sleep
4:19am - I took a great piss - this is when the shampoo bottles in the shower started morphing. The psychedelic trip is still realized. A true dose of something is what I got.
4:42am - Did some sketches in my notebook and went to bed.
Woke up at 8am, quite tired as I only slept 3hrs. I would not have taken it at this day or time If I had been expecting a trip. But I enjoyed the strange beauty and introspection of the experience. The most significant effects were mental, I rated it (++M+P+E+S+C+F).
Writing this the following morning. After a good nights sleep I feel 'normal'. I feel good about things and myself.
[Reported Dose: ''Half tab, less than .15g hash'']
